prompt:
Fix snippets/allergen-badges.liquid so it renders a list of allergen badges with every piece of text safely escaped, both in element text and in attribute values. Inputs (top-level variables only, nothing under section.settings): - `allergens`: array of strings, or null. Strings are never null and must be output as given (no stripping, no case changes). - `label`: string or null; the accessible name of the list. Output rules: - If `allergens` is null or an empty array, output nothing (empty string). - Otherwise output exactly, with no whitespace or newlines between any tags: `
    ITEMS
` LABEL is `label` when it is a non-empty string, and the literal text `Allergens` when `label` is null or the empty string. LABEL is HTML-escaped. - ITEMS is one element per allergen, in input order: `
  • NAME
    • ` where NAME is the allergen string HTML-escaped in both places. - HTML escaping means Liquid `escape`: & < > " ' become & < > " '. Apply it to the raw value exactly once, so text that already contains an entity such as `&` must have its ampersand escaped again (`&`). - No leading or trailing whitespace in the output. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/allergen-badges.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
